text.tspan: Global Hunger Index vs. GDP per capita 2021
The Global Hunger Index is measured on a 100-point scale where 0 is the best (no hunger) and 100 the worst.
GDP per capita is adjusted for inflation and differences in living costs between countries.
GDP per capita (international-$ in 2021 prices; plotted on a logarithmic axis)

tspan.tspan: Concern Worldwide and Welthungerhilfe (2021); Eurostat, OECD, IMF, and World Bank (2026)
GDP per capita is expressed in international-$ at 2021 prices.
